---
title: "Edit a Product"
description: "Change a product you have already submitted to the marketplace."
---

You edit a product from its detail page in the Vendor Portal. Every change is submitted to the marketplace as a change request, so your edits take effect once an operator approves them.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the products list">
    Go to **Products** in the sidebar. The page lists every product you sell, with its status. Select the product you want to edit.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/edit-a-product/step-1.png" alt="Open the products list" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open the product">
    Selecting a row opens the product's detail page.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Edit the product">
    The detail page groups the product into sections: general information, media, options, variants, and organization. Each section has an **Edit** action that opens a drawer for those fields. Make your change and save it. The edit is submitted as a change request and appears as pending until an operator reviews it.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/edit-a-product/step-3.png" alt="Edit the product" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
</Steps>
